name: 电影感HorizonatDusk
lyrics:
[主歌1]

消逝 lights across the 天空
Colors melting into 夜
Every moment passes by
Slowly 消逝 out of sight

[副歌]

Horizon at dusk
Where the daylight 相遇 the dust
Every memory will fade away
Into the evening grey

[主歌2]

Silent echoes in the air
Shadows dancing everywhere
时间 消融 like morning haze
Lost within the twilight phase

[副歌]

Horizon at dusk
Where the daylight 相遇 the dust
All the moments we once made
Slowly start to fade

[副歌]

Whispers of tomorrow, 轻柔 and low

name: 慢节奏MidnightUrbanLullaby
lyrics:
[主歌1]

City lights reflection on glass,
Midnight windows watching us,
Neon glow in quiet streets,
Where the 寂静 and the city 相遇

[副歌]

Late 夜 city, slow and deep,
In the glow we learn to breathe,
Every 光芒 a story told,
In this city, calm and 寒冷

[主歌2]

Coffee steam against the dark,
Downtempo beats mark the spark,
Synthesizer waves wash the room,
Like the city in the monsoon gloom.

[副歌]

Late 夜 city, slow and deep,
In the glow we learn to breathe,
Every 光芒 a story told,
In this city, calm and 寒冷

[桥段]

Bass drops like rain on empty lanes,
Melancholy wrapped in 轻柔 refrains,
The 夜 moves on, we stay behind,
In the warmth of city 夜 unwind.

[尾声]

City sleeps but lights stay on,
Downtempo plays until the 黎明,
In the glow we close our eyes,
Under the vast urban 夜 skies.

name: 慢节奏城LightsSerenade
lyrics:
[主歌1]

City lights are glowing 明亮,
Painting shadows 穿过 the 夜,
Every window tells a story,
Silent tales of hope and glory.

[副歌]

Serenade the midnight air,
Let the quiet soothe your care,
Lights below like 星辰 above,
低语 gently, this is love.

[主歌2]

Neon signs begin to fade,
In the quiet late-night shade,
Footsteps echo, distant train,
Gently falling, 轻柔 like rain.

[副歌]

Serenade the midnight air,
Let the peace replace the care,
Lights below like 星辰 above,
低语 gently, this is love.
